description: Record the invoice issued for an order: its number, and optionally a link and the invoicing system. cmssy stores the reference only; it issues no document. An order holds one invoice: repeating the same number is a no-op, a different number is refused, and a canceled order is refused. To correct an invoiced order use record_order_invoice_correction. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

number.description: Invoice number as issued by the invoicing system

name: record_order_invoice
title: Record order invoice
